title: Scale-Dependent Loop Corrections to the Inflationary Power Spectrum
summary: Loop corrections to primordial correlation functions are unavoidable due to the non-linear nature of gravity. Previous works have established a robust framework for computing the renormalised one-loop power spectra of scalar and tensor modes, but primarily in (near) de Sitter backgrounds. In this work, we develop a consistent renormalisation procedure applicable to inflationary backgrounds that strongly break de Sitter symmetries and generate scale-dependent features in the primordial spectra.
